issue.detail: Spec does not define initial q at power-up before any reset; contract states COUNT advances 0..9 but no initial value. Alternative semantics: q starts at 0 vs q starts at unknown/9.
issue.spec_evidence: Build a decade counter that counts from 0 through 9, inclusive, with a period of 10.
issue.alternative: Initial q is 0 at time zero (before any posedge) rather than unknown; distinguishing sequence: first row reset=0, then reset=0. Under init-0 semantics outputs q=0 then q=1; under unknown-init semantics first output is undefined.

issue.detail: Spec says period 10 but does not state whether q=9 persists for one cycle then wraps (standard) or whether wrap occurs same cycle as reaching 9. Contract R3 wraps on posedge when q==9, giving 10 distinct values 0..9. Alternative: wrap when q==8 so period 9.
issue.spec_evidence: counts from 0 through 9, inclusive, with a period of 10
issue.alternative: Counter wraps from 8 to 0 (period 9) instead of 9 to 0; distinguishing sequence from q=8: reset=0, reset=0, reset=0 gives q=9,0,1 under contract vs q=0,1,2 under alternative.
